brief: Prioritise Stonebridge Lock 230/34kV (SUB-SGW-325) for pre-event attention because units of advanced age with a history of high loading have a reduced margin against mechanical failure. Where this ageing unit cannot be attended before the forecast heat event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure. Oil treatment restores dielectric strength, but it does not restore the paper insulation.
